# Probability of Getting a Sum of 13 with Two Dice

The probability is **0** (impossible).

## Why?

A standard die has faces numbered **1 through 6**. The maximum value on each die is 6, so the highest possible sum with two dice is:

$$6 + 6 = 12$$

Since **13 > 12**, there is no combination of two standard dice that can produce a sum of 13.

$$P(\text{sum} = 13) = 0$$
